translation.name: Biblica® Wonhia ɛho kwamma nhoma Akuapem Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content.text: Ao, sɛ me ti yɛ asuti,
na mʼaniwa yɛ nusu abura a!
ama me nkurɔfo a wɔakunkum wɔn no.
te sɛ agyan de di atoro;
di yiye wɔ asase yi so.
munnye obiara nni wɔ mo abusua mu.
Efisɛ wɔn mu biara yɛ ɔdaadaafo,
na wɔn mu biara nka nokware.
na wɔn nnaadaa mu wɔmpɛ sɛ wogye me to mu,”

content: Ɛno nti, sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se,

content.text: na dɛn bio na metumi ayɛ
esiane me nkurɔfo yi bɔne nti?
Wɔn tɛkrɛma yɛ agyan a ano wɔ bɔre;
Obiara kasa asomdwoe mu kyerɛ ne yɔnko,
nanso ne koma mu de, osum no afiri.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ metwe wɔn aso wɔ eyi ho?”
ɔman a ɛte sɛɛ so were ana?
Mesu na metwa adwo ama mmepɔw no,
mɛbɔ abubuw a ɛfa nweatam adidibea ho.
Ayɛ fo na obi mfa hɔ bio,
na wɔnte anantwi su wɔ hɔ.
na mmoa no nso aguan kɔ.
na mɛma Yuda nkurow ada mpan

content: Onipa bɛn na onim nyansa ara sɛ ɔbɛte eyi ase? Hena na Awurade akyerɛkyerɛ no a obetumi akyerɛ ase? Adɛn nti na wɔasɛe asase no ama ada mpan sɛ nweatam a obiara ntumi mfa so?
Awurade kae se, “Esiane sɛ wɔapo me mmara a mehyɛ maa wɔn no nti, wɔanyɛ osetie amma me na wɔanni me mmara so.
Mmom, wɔadi wɔn koma asoɔden akyi, wɔadi Baalnom akyi sɛnea wɔn agyanom kyerɛɛ wɔn no.”
Ɛno nti, nea Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn no se ni: “Hwɛ, mɛma saa nnipa yi adi aduan a ɛyɛ nwen na wɔanom nsu a wɔde awuduru afra.
Mɛbɔ wɔn ahwete amanaman a wɔn anaa wɔn agyanom nnim so no so, na mede afoa bɛtaa wɔn kosi sɛ mɛsɛe wɔn.”

content.text: frɛ wɔn a wɔakwadaw mu pa ara.
kosi sɛ yɛn ani so bɛtaa nusu
Wɔte agyaadwotwa nnyigyei fi Sion se,
Ɛsɛ sɛ yetu fi yɛn asase so
Afei, mo mmea, muntie Awurade asɛm;
monyɛ aso mma nsɛm a efi nʼanom.
Monkyerɛ mo mmabea sɛnea wotwa dwo;
monkyerɛ mo ho mo ho abubuwbɔ.
Owu aforo afa yɛn mfɛnsere mu
te sɛ sumina a egugu petee mu,
te sɛ aburow a nnɔbaetwafo atwa agu nʼakyi
“Mma onyansafo mfa ne nyansa nhyehyɛ ne ho
anaa ɔhoɔdenfo mfa nʼahoɔden nhyehyɛ ne ho
anaa ɔdefo mfa nʼahonya nhyehyɛ ne ho.
Mmom ma nea ɔhyehyɛ ne ho nhyehyɛ ne ho sɛ
me ne Awurade a ɔyɛ adɔe,
na obu atɛntrenee na ɔyɛ adetrenee wɔ asase so,

content: “Nna no reba,” Awurade na ose, “A mɛtwe wɔn a wɔatwa twetia wɔ honam fam nko ara no nyinaa aso:
Misraimfo, Yudafo, Edomfo, Amonfo, Moabfo ne wɔn a wɔtete nweatam a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri nsase so nyinaa. Na nokware, saa aman yi nyinaa yɛ momonotofo na mpo Israelfi nyinaa yɛ koma mu momonotofo.”
